intent: Check existence of Engelbert Strauss Classic e.s. 37H-N9K Work Trousers (color Black) in the catalogue.
success_criteria: If matching product variant exists, answer message contains <YES> token and full path to the variant record; otherwise contains <NO> token.

args.stdin:
SELECT pv.record_path
FROM product_variants pv
JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pv.product_sku = pvp.product_sku
WHERE pv.brand = :brand
  AND pv.series = :series
  AND pv.model = :model
  AND pv.product_name LIKE :product_name_like
  AND pvp.property_key = 'color_family'
  AND pvp.property_value_text = :color
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CASE
  WHEN EXISTS(
    SELECT 1
    FROM product_variants pv
    JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pv.product_sku = pvp.product_sku
    WHERE pv.brand = :brand
      AND pv.series = :series
      AND pv.model = :model
      AND pv.product_name LIKE :product_name_like
      AND pvp.property_key = 'color_family'
      AND pvp.property_value_text = :color
  ) THEN '<YES> Product found: ' || (
    SELECT pv.record_path
    FROM product_variants pv
    JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pv.product_sku = pvp.product_sku
    WHERE pv.brand = :brand
      AND pv.series = :series
      AND pv.model = :model
      AND pv.product_name LIKE :product_name_like
      AND pvp.property_key = 'color_family'
      AND pvp.property_value_text = :color
    LIMIT 1
  )
  ELSE '<NO> No matching product in catalogue'
END AS answer_msg;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context
When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
